summary: Generate local L1 rows for the paired span set with Qwen3.8-27B
description:
Generate the local arm: build_dossiers.py --generate --stage l1 --db <snapshot>, restricted to the paired works. generate_dossiers.py has NO --db flag of its own — it is the --generate half of build_dossiers.py and must be driven through it.

Server: llm qwen3.8. Context is not a constraint (spans are ~6000 tokens), so the oversized agent-tuned window is harmless. Thinking should stay ON — l1-v3 asks the model to 're-check each such statement against the input' before finishing, which is exactly what the thinking pass is for — but cap it with THINK_BUDGET so a stuck generation ends with an answer instead of finish_reason=length.

Announce the GPU grab; llm stop when finished. Est. 1-2h for ~44 spans.

Rows land as pending under model='Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf', namespaced by (unit, model, prompt_version), so they cannot clobber the frontier rows.

DONE: one pending local l1-v3 row per paired span, zero generation errors, and any log-skips (MAX_ATTEMPTS=3 exhausted) counted and recorded here — a high skip rate is itself a FORMAT result worth reporting.

resolution.note: 36/36 paired spans generated, zero skips. 52 calls / 16 retries (42% of spans needed >=1). 15 of 16 retries were length-band overruns (727-1538 tok vs ~300 target); 1 was mid-sentence start. Post-correction the local arm is +17.7% longer than frontier (483.6 vs 410.2), ratio 1.16-1.21 across all three works. ~70 tok/s pinned single-card vs 48.3 split. Full detail: docs/dossiers/c8-local-l1-run.md
